text: Olivia is 9. She has cerebral palsy, uses a wheelchair and a communication board. She has a g-tube and gets NOTHING by mouth, not even water, even if she reaches for a snack. If the tube comes out, cover the site with gauze (in her bag) and call me right away, it has to go back in within an hour or the hole starts closing. She had seizures as a baby but none since she was 3, she came off Depakote two years ago and there's no seizure plan anymore. She laughs at everything.
